proposed_minimal_contract.typed_plan: Add explicit NPC phase kind and optional typed Phase.npc_intent (default None, appended for constructor compatibility). Exactly one NPC phase admitted for this slice; no destination/species/item. Intent operation enum next/choose/close, binding npc_id + epoch + map_name + opened_sequence + prompt_sequence + expected_stage, and optional exact received option_index for choose only. Positive strict integer IDs/cursors, reject bools, duplicates/unknown keys and contradictory fields. PlanningIdentity remains request-owned; no arbitrary executable text/native commands. Objective/reason and existing bounded duration/review/fallback/safety/replan fields retained.
proposed_minimal_contract.admission_data: Append optional typed NPC admission observation to Capabilities, default None for old callers, constructed from fresh host-owned received state: dialogue binding, current received NPC actor presence/kind/range, alive/transport/frame continuity/map/arrival readiness and session identity. Advisory job copy may inform schema but is never authorization. Domain NPC semantics compare plan receipt exactly to current typed observation at actual lifecycle admission; the host action validator repeats all prerequisites immediately before any dispatch. Generic required_facts npc string alone is insufficient.
proposed_minimal_contract.admission_gate: Advertise NPC only under an explicitly enabled separately approved capability when current same-owner/character/world/ruleset/session/map received dialogue is actionable and the actor is actually visible/reachable. Require bounded monotonic freshness with no received-frame gaps or pending movement, matching open/prompt receipt and expected stage. choose must use an index present in the exact current options; next/close require an allowed received stage. New/unrecognized string input => hold and bounded replan, not answer. Public source knowledge supplies neither actor visibility nor Training Grounds eligibility. Any eligibility-changing, spending, reward or quest objective remains unsupported.
proposed_minimal_contract.progress: Add narrowly named NPC UI advanced / NPC UI closed observable conditions with operation-specific semantics. Completion requires a newer relevant received UI event for the same npc/epoch/map/opened_sequence, not action emission, a global frame increase, unrelated chat or repeat same prompt. NEXT/CHOOSE complete on a genuinely changed received prompt/page/stage; CLOSE on explicit matching received close. Freshness loss/missing actor is stop, never proof of close/success. Terminal receipt recorded once; no further command until another LLM-authored admitted plan.
proposed_minimal_contract.limits: One action per (plan identity/version,npc_id,opened_sequence,prompt_sequence,operation), zero retransmission in this first slice; finite 3-second receipt timeout and max 30-second plan/review window proposed for approval. A matching changed but unexpected stage, missing receipt, review expiry, actor/transport/frame loss, danger or epoch/map/name change stops requests and supplies an evidenced bounded/coalesced replan reason. Existing lifecycle single physical worker, retry/cooldown/timeout ownership must remain; while pending retain safe IDLE and keepalive, no legacy NPC fallback.
proposed_minimal_contract.execution_split: LLM selects received guidance menu option and authors the bound intent. CLEF may only continue/hold/replan and adapt request timing within this one validated phase. Unknown/unplanned menus are LLM replan, not CLEF plan authorship. Deterministic host state machine issues NEXT/CHOOSE/CLOSE using approved controller primitives and waits for received UI. Explicit name submission remains the other owner's pending primitive, not string autoanswer.
proposed_minimal_contract.host_interfaces: Extend PlannedBrain.bind_session with a defaulted NPC read-only observation/eligibility seam, preserving pose_reader. Host supplies current actor/transport/frame/dialogue receipts and existing action dispatch; future AgentHost/session binding must thread this seam, and the PlayingClient seam must be agreed only after its current owner finishes. Exact mutable implementation/line numbers not audited. Extend _capabilities, runtime.poll/lifecycle.admit typed comparison, _execution_current to prompt binding, event routing/dedupe for NpcDialogueReceived without REST pose dependence, and step_script to a narrowly isolated one-command NPC hold. Use actual agent tick/action dispatch; no new model transport or native packet implementation here.
proposed_minimal_contract.serialization_and_migration: Update _phase/decode_plan, generated _schemas/_constrain_plan_schema, Phase.valid/ProposedPlan.denial and operation-specific observable validation together. Add conditional strict npc_intent schema and current option vocabulary from caller data; do not leak unsupported name intent. execution_request asdict must detach/JSON-encode nested typed fields and expose real current phase/progress instead of a misleading generic 0; this one-phase slice keeps index 0 valid. planning_job_context typed JSON budget/deepcopy must retain NPC fields/freshness. Preserve old non-NPC payloads/constructor defaults, exact required top-level key set, fallback enum and REST/IDLE behavior; no existing schema change now. On later approval version the new NPC contract/opt-in and reject unknown versions, or provide an explicit old-plan reader with default npc_intent=None; persistence/dashboard consumers must be located/reviewed separately before activation, not silently migrated. InvestigationReadPort.read/PlanningModel.complete need no new methods.
